situation.person: Mother around 4 weeks postpartum in the first 8 weeks with lingering symptoms, Googling at 2am while the household sleeps
situation.specific_situation: Low mood, numbness and frightening thoughts linger past the two-week blues mark without a name, so she minimizes them by day and searches them by night, and no route to professional care is ever taken.
situation.trigger: Symptoms lingering past the two-week mark after a difficult delivery, now alone all day.
situation.problem: No non-diagnostic screen exists, therefore distress stays unnamed and no route to professional care is ever taken.
situation.failed_attempt: Prayed harder and the guilt only deepened; told herself it was just the blues and it did not pass; Googled and found worst-case diagnoses.
constraints: without a name, so she minimizes them by day and searches

situation.desired_transformation: She can name what is happening without diagnosing, and a written same-day route to professional care exists and is followed.
